image_description: A pile of cooked Dungeness crabs displayed in a glass seafood case. The crabs are stacked on top of each other, showing their ventral (underside) surfaces which are cream/orange colored. The legs and claws are visible, tangled in the pile. The background shows a blurred deli/seafood counter environment with lighting fixtures.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are stalked and protrude from anterior carapace margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crabs are stacked and primarily viewed from the ventral side or obscured by other crabs; eyes are not clearly visible on any specific subject.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace is smooth and convex displaying purplish-brown to reddish-brown coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Most visible surfaces are the ventral side (cream/orange). The dorsal carapace color is largely occluded or affected by strong yellow ambient lighting, making accurate color verification impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is cream to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the crabs is clearly visible and matches the expected cream/light orange coloration of cooked Dungeness crab ventral surfaces.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad oval carapace of substantial edible-crab proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The general shape of the crab bodies visible in the stack conforms to the broad, oval geometry typical of Dungeness crabs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace displays lighter mottled patterns over purplish-brown base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Dorsal patterns are not visible due to the angle (ventral view) and stacking.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Exoskeleton is hard and calcified with smooth glossy texture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shells exhibit specular highlights consistent with a hard, smooth, calcified exoskeleton.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five pairs of walking legs extend laterally.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple legs are visible extending from the body margins. While counting exactly five pairs per crab is difficult due to occlusion, the visible limb density and arrangement are consistent with decapod anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: First pair modified into robust claws of unequal size with dark tips.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Robust chelipeds (claws) are visible. They appear to have darker coloration at the tips (pincers), consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Claws have smooth outer surface and serrated inner edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Resolution is insufficient to verify microscopic details like serrations on the inner edge of the claws.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the price tags and background signs is illegible and morphologically inconsistent (gibberish shapes), a common AI artifact in text rendering.

Some boundaries between adjacent crab legs and shells blend slightly without clear occlusion shadows, suggesting minor fusion artifacts typical of generative models handling complex overlapping objects.

artifact_observations.location: Glass case frame and background shelves
artifact_observations.reasoning: The horizontal lines of the display case and background shelves show slight waviness and inconsistency in perspective convergence.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' artifact between the crabs. In real photos, heavy occlusion creates deep shadows; in AI images, this often manifests as blurry blending. Verify if the lack of distinct shadows between legs is an artifact or just poor lighting. Also, scrutinize the text artifacts as they are a strong indicator of generation.
